question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Effective
solution:
The correct answer is '**Fruitless**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word** "Effective" is: Fruitless.**
 
• Meaning of the words:
 
 
• **Deniable** (मान्यता से इनकार किया जा सकने वाला) - capable of being denied or contradicted.
 
• **Harmonious** (मेल-मिलापपूर्ण) - marked by agreement in feeling, attitude, or action.
 
• **Fruitless** (निष्फल) - producing no result or effect; unsuccessful.
 
• **Courteous** (शिष्ट) - polite, respectful, or considerate in manner. 
 
 
 
• *Sentence: The committee's efforts to improve **efficiency** proved fruitless as there was no noticeable change in productivity.*
 
• Explanation: "**Effective**" means producing a desired or intended result. Its antonym "**Fruitless**" means producing no result or being unsuccessful. In the context of the passage, if **certain people were considered effective,** the opposite of that would be individuals or efforts that do not produce the desired outcomes.

5e:T815,

The correct answer is 'Most Effective Colleagues'.<
